## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10712 — one family, folded into its closure card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T20:34Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10712, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same class, same fix: a superseded answer lands last and replaces the current one, because only the latest call should commit. The family's data-view card, objectui#10684, is in flight (PR objectui#10711) and is not folded into. objectui#10712 is the closure card for the positions that census held out, the forms and the field widgets. It now carries this row (`useRecordQuery`, and through it `LookupField`, the people picker and `RecordPickerDialog`) with its `renderHook` measurement, at `priority:p2`. The current gate folds same-family findings into one closure card (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110). Neither card was claimed when the fold was made.
